title: The Women Pirates Who Escaped the Noose #Shorts
description:
Two of the most famous pirates in history were women. In 1720, Anne Bonny and Mary Read sailed with the pirate Calico Jack in the Caribbean. When their ship was captured, the two women were put on trial in Jamaica... and both were sentenced to hang.
